Records.description: Two-loop four-point function occurring in Higgs+jet production via gluon fusion at two loops, with an elliptic sub-sector. Six propagators: five massive (mass m, top quark) and one massless. Four external legs: p1, p2, p3 massless (gluons/jet); p4 off-shell (Higgs, p4^2=m_H^2). Has 5 Feynman parameters and depends on four kinematic invariants (s, t, m^2, p4^2). Analytic results contain elliptic functions. Matches pySecDec example elliptic2L_physical. Used as benchmark for neural network contour deformation optimization.

Records.description: Two-loop H+jet with closed top loop. 6 propagators (5 massive top, 1 massless). Maximal cut reveals elliptic curve.

Planar double-box with five massive and one massless internal propagator, four external legs (three massless, one massive with $p_4^2=m_h^2$). Four master integrals; in $d=4$ one decouples and the remaining three reduce to a $2\times 2$ coupled system (since $\mathrm{Cut}(I_3)=0$). The second-order DE is solved by the maximal cut in terms of complete elliptic integrals $K(\omega)$ where $\omega = 16 m^2 \sqrt{-s t u m_h^2} / [s(m_h^2-t)^2 - 4m^2(m_h^2(s-t)+t(s+t)-2 \sqrt{-s t u m_h^2})]$.

Two-loop four-point box-triangle of Bonciani et al. (denoted $I^A_{66}$) with five massive propagators forming the box subgraph and one massless rung; one external leg $p_4$ is off-shell ($p_4^2 \neq 0$), the other three are massless. The hexa-cut is computed in Baikov variables, reduces to a one-fold integral over the square root of a quartic, and evaluates to a complete elliptic integral of the first kind $K$, confirming that the cut is genuinely elliptic. Result valid in the physical region $m^2>0, s>0, p_4^2>0, t<0, u<0$.
